hsbm_review.decision: Adopt as a bounded candidate-discovery method in the checker and shared-corpus portfolio; do not make it the exclusive frontier or require a broad scoring prototype before obvious useful test repairs.
hsbm_review.corrected_reachability: For num_threads, the supported novelty is the omitted-field path changing from 1 to 0. Explicit numeric zero was already a public usize/config input; do not assert zero was globally unreachable before Serde. Define interface, state abstraction and transition rather than using unqualified Post minus Pre.
hsbm_review.taxonomy: Reachability/default transition; validation-strength or cache-history distinction; safety enforcement addition; feature interaction; representation change; and test non-vacuity/wiring. Safety additions can shrink accepted states, so the useful umbrella is historical assurance boundaries, not only set expansion.
evidence_fields: implementation-local or qualified normative obligation authority
hsbm_review.avoid_overclaim: Historical intent nominates an obligation; current source safety can justify preventive tests but does not establish Lean semantics. Resource existence is not executable coverage; helper tests are not automatically semantic regressions; coverage absence requires a scoped test audit.

bounded_pilot.prerequisite: Bounded primary literature and tool-reuse assessment for change-aware test generation, test amplification, regression test selection and history-guided mutation; retain a reuse/extend/stop decision before building new scoring tooling.
bounded_pilot.sample: Freeze one exact history interval and a non-merge population, deterministic explainable score and tie break, six ranked commits across at least three strata, and two mechanically selected low-score controls. Record the already discussed zero-thread, infer-cache, safety, native-config and newly observed literal-test cases as discovery anchors excluded from prospective yield.
bounded_pilot.per_commit: At most two candidate boundaries and one nominated regression; fixed follow-up window such as the next five non-merge commits plus a separate current-test continuity check.
bounded_pilot.success_criterion: At least two non-anchor candidates from the frozen sample have current-source continuity, a scoped contract, evidence of missing isolation, a small implementable test design, and a concrete contribution path. Report all candidates and analyst minutes, including negatives and unresolved cases.
bounded_pilot.limits: The first pilot establishes prospective actionability only. Superiority over broad mutation triage requires an equal-budget comparator and should not be claimed from this pilot or from PR #32.
bounded_pilot.successors: Implement the highest-value admitted regression as one bounded local item; if all candidates are covered, stop scoring-tool investment and prioritize existing corpus/semantic items; if expected outcomes are ambiguous, route one candidate into semantic clarification; if ordinary export portability is established, route one into Arena integration.
